john_paul.name: John
john_paul.prompt: Edit reference image 1, a transparent 12-pose John Lennon sheet. Preserve the sheet layout, the transparent background, the clothing, instruments, and all eleven drawings other than the TOP LEFT FRONT-VIEW figure. Fix ONLY that top-left figure's face to the 1965 cartoon JOHN, not George. Reference image 2 is the original series portrait frame: from left to right it shows GEORGE, JOHN, PAUL, RINGO. John's face is the SECOND portrait: distinctly broad elongated U-shaped rounded-square jaw/chin, long vertical nose, a broad cheek/chin area below the mouth, confident sideways half-lidded eyes, short squared sideburns, NO pointed tapered chin. Reference image 3 also shows John as the large colored hands-on-hips figure at lower center. Match that John identity exactly in the top left figure while keeping its body and pose. No text, no new poses. Flat clean cel-animation ink and colors, true transparent background.

john_paul.name: Paul
john_paul.prompt: Edit reference image 1, a transparent 12-pose Paul McCartney sheet. Preserve layout, transparency, suit, body proportions, instruments, and eleven drawings other than the TOP LEFT FRONT-VIEW figure. Fix ONLY that top-left figure's face to the 1965 cartoon PAUL, not George. Reference image 2 shows four original series portraits: left to right GEORGE, JOHN, PAUL, RINGO. Paul is the THIRD portrait: soft compact rounded face, full rounded cheeks, delicate short nose, large oval expressive eyes, curved eyebrows, small cupid-bow smiling mouth. He must not have George's long narrow pointed face. Reference image 3 shows Paul as the large colored arms-folded figure at lower left. Precisely preserve this softer Paul face, mop-top and slim neck in the top-left view. Keep body and all other eleven poses untouched. No text or new poses. Flat cel animation and true transparent background.

ringo: Edit reference image 1, a transparent 12-pose Ringo Starr character sheet. Fix ONLY the face of the TOP LEFT front-facing figure; preserve the body, clothes, transparency, exact layout and all eleven other figures. In reference image 2, the original 1965 cartoon portrait frame shows GEORGE, JOHN, PAUL, RINGO left-to-right. Ringo is the FOURTH, rightmost portrait. His front-view face has a VERY LARGE broad drooping pear/teardrop-shaped nose covering most of the middle of the face, curved smile below the nose and very small narrow chin. His huge nose MUST NOT be a thin straight line in front view. Copy the fourth portrait's nose-to-eye-to-mouth proportions faithfully in clean cel-animation outlines; small half-lidded eyes, shaggy black mop-top flaring at nape. Do not substitute George's thin long nose, John's broad jaw, or Paul's small nose. Reference image 3 shows the same Ringo at the upper far right. No text. Preserve all other eleven drawings unchanged. True transparent background.
